text: 安哥拉央行表示，允许商业银行使用人民币满足外汇存款准备金要求的决定，将降低货币兑换成本并改善流动性。安哥拉国家银行于7月6日将人民币纳入银行可用于满足存款准备金要求的货币范围，与美元、欧元和南非兰特并列。（彭博）
text_en: Angola's central bank stated that allowing commercial banks to use the yuan to meet foreign exchange reserve requirements will reduce currency conversion costs and improve liquidity. On July 6, Angola's National Bank added the yuan to the range of currencies banks can use for reserve requirements, alongside the US dollar, euro, and South African rand. (Bloomberg)
